_README: THE preserved-user-state set. Angela, 2026-08-12. Everything named here is the USER'S, not the build's: it must survive a self-update AND a reinstall over an existing directory. Three programs act on this list - install.py (skips these when extracting pkg.zip), apply_update.ps1 (its $Preserve array) and uninstall.py - and they used to keep three private copies of it. They drifted: apply_update.ps1 preserved external_mcps.json while install.py preserved NOTHING at all, so a self-update kept the user's MCP servers and a reinstall silently deleted them along with config.json, contacts.json and the chat history. One list, one truth, pinned by agent/test_preserved_user_state.py.

_notes.config.json: every provider key + every setting the user chose
_notes.external_mcps.json: the External MCP catalog AND its active set - secrets live in its env blocks
_notes.contacts.json: the people the messaging agents resolve by name
_notes.DB: chat history and the enable/disable toggles
_notes.Temp: scratch, but also pasted screenshots the user may still be referring to
_notes.Templates: scaffolded project trees - deliverables, not build output
_notes.Uninstaller.exe: built separately, never inside pkg.zip; without this a reinstall deletes it
